svg.title: Robot Curling start and target
svg.desc: Top view along the arena's long axis. The robot graphic is rendered from the World space model. The start line touches the robot's front. Distance d, from that front-center point to the target, is 1.3 to 2.3 metres.
svg.metadata: World model: apps/dashboard/src/world-scene-renderer.ts; addRobotModel SHA-256: c811b2ed8daaa916d374b02dfbd319af5505926d0a175399a3720ea52356a8c1. The nonphysical ConeGeometry direction pointer is omitted; all hardware geometry and materials are retained. Generated by docs/revisions/2026-10-06-controller-instructions/render-distance-diagram.mjs. Schematic, not to scale.
